mapper.select: SELECT kbo.kingdee_user_code AS code, kbo.erp_user_id AS userId, kbo.kingdee_user_name AS userName FROM kingdee_business_operator kbo INNER JOIN sys_accounting_company sac ON sac.code=kbo.kingdee_org_code INNER JOIN sys_user_info su ON su.uid=kbo.erp_user_id WHERE kbo.kingdee_type=#{type} AND sac.id=#{orgId} AND su.delete_state=1 AND su.user_state=1
